comparison.objective: Hold an SO-101 shoulder bracket aloft while inserting a servo into its close-fit pocket in the correct orientation.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually support a loose part, orient a servo, perform close-clearance insertion, press it home, and set the assembly down.
comparison.success_condition: Servo is correctly oriented, aligned, and fully seated; bracket is upright and released, with both arms retracted.
comparison.reason: Close-fit robot assembly insertion is meaningfully different from adjustment-and-test commissioning. The body provides explicit step thresholds but no separate task-spec version.
